title: AGENTS.md
text: Write-host, read-many consumers, COW mutation. share() allocates fresh region; existing regions never mutated. locking anywhere — change admitting -place mutation breaks model. Names embed creator PID + randomly-seeded per-process counter (mori_<pid>_<counter>, mori_region_name). mori_shm_create uses O_EXCL / ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS; collision (orphan crashed -PID process) error (MORI_EEXIST), never worked around reuse. prune_shared() clears orphans; must run PID free — live process reap names. host writes full region name observable — partial writes never seen. Consumer mappings read-(PROT_READ / FILE_MAP_READ); mutation triggers COW. Fork safety: mori_shm records creator PID; mori_host_finalizer unlinks getpid() match, forked child’s inherited finalizers skip unlink (munmap process-local) — parallel::mclapply forks destroy parent regions.

title: AGENTS.md
text: Magic first 4 bytes (MORI_MAGIC_*): MORH 0x4D4F5248 vector, MORL 0x4D4F524C list, MORS 0x4D4F5253 string. Every layout opens 64-byte header; bytes [24-31] reserved embedder cross-process state, [32-35] hold mori flags word (bit 0: S4 object bit), [36-63] reserved (zeroed every write — embedders may recycle regions). Tables canonical spec; mori_nested_write / morh_write / mors_write (mori_serialize_into fallbacks attrs) implementations. Attributes serialized R objects (pairlist R < 4.6, named list otherwise); mori_restore_attrs reapplies consumer. MORH — atomic vector. Data byte 64 (64-byte aligned SIMD); trailing attrs data. MORL — ALTLIST. Header + element directory + per-element data regions. Directory entry (32 bytes): data_offset(8) + data_size(8) + sexptype(4) + attrs_size(4) + length(8). sexptype: 0 → serialized bytes (serialize.c); STRSXP → offset table + packed strings data_offset; VECSXP → nested MORL region inlined data_offset size data_size (child header/directory/elements/attrs inline; parent’s attrs_size always 0 VECSXP children); → raw zero-copy data, bit 30 sexptype (MORI_ELEM_S4) flagging S4 leaf (masked read). Non-VECSXP attrs sit data_offset + data_size - attrs_size. MORS — ALTSTRING. Header + offset table + packed string bytes + optional trailing attrs. Offset-table entry (16 bytes): str_offset(int64, relative packed area) + str_length(int32, < 0 = NA) + str_encoding(int32, cetype_t: 0=native, 1=UTF-8, 2=Latin-1, 3=bytes). layout inlined STRSXP elements MORL regions (table element’s data_offset; element attrs use directory entry’s attrs_size).

title: AGENTS.md
text: SHM lifetime automatic via chained extptr finalizers. Three interned tags (C globals altrep.c): mori_shm_tag — SHM mapping extptr (sides). Addr mori_shm *; finalizer munmap. mori_host_tag — host-unlink extptr mori_make_result; addr mori_shm * (name POSIX, HANDLE Windows); finalizer shm_unlink/CloseHandle, skipped creator pid ≠ getpid() (fork guard). Chained shm extptr. mori_owned_tag — every malloc-backed extptr: ALTREP data1 (view/vec/str) bare path-walk intermediates (mori_make_view_extptr, always mori_list_view *). Addr type ALTREP boundary TYPEOF(x): VECSXP → mori_list_view *, STRSXP → mori_str *, else mori_vec *. index field: -1 standalone/root, >= 0 element. Finalizer mori_owned_finalizer: release hook , free. Release hook: every owned struct embeds mori_owned (release + release_arg) first member, finalizer recovers addr. Fires exactly (mori_release_once’s NULL store) — COW materialization finalizer, whichever first; internal callers pass NULL. ALTLIST views fire finalizer : extracted elements keep referencing region. is_shared() = mori_view_check (ALTREP mori_owned_tag data1). mori_shm_name() = mori_format_chain (bare prefix roots, path form sub-objects).

title: AGENTS.md
text: Host: mori_shm_create mmaps (POSIX fd closed mmap); mori_make_result splits ownership — ALTREP gets mapping (mori_shm_tag extptr), host unlink extptr chained prot. finalizers run GC; R_RegisterCFinalizerEx(..., TRUE) covers session exit. Consumer: mori_shm_open maps read-(never unlinks). Prefix-opened lists: shm extptr → root view extptr (index -1) → data1; Elt sub-lists chain parent views. Path-form: intermediates bare extptrs, leaf gets ALTLIST. Element vec/str extptrs’ prot parent view (shm extptr root). Lifetime: leaves pin root SHM chain (leaf → views → shm → host); every R_MakeExternalPtr retains prot, chain survives GC enclosing ALTLISTs. mori_format_chain chain walker (mori_owned_tag hops, always mori_list_view *).

title: AGENTS.md
text: Linux: /dev/shm tmpfs via open()/unlink() directly (avoids -lrt dependency). MAP_POPULATE pre-faults. macOS: shm_open/shm_unlink (libc); MAP_POPULATE -op. kernel namespace can’t enumerated (invisible creator dies), reaping uses per-user registry TMPDIR: one append-log per process (<dir>/mori_<pid>, file per region — one write() ~1 µs vs ~40 µs file creation), opened lazily first share mori_log_append (sole creator; retries mkdir ENOENT). Single-writer ⇒ locking; readers reapers dead PIDs. mori_log_release tracks live-region count; zero unlinks log rmdirs dir. count incremented even logging fails (forfeits reapability, never region). Fork-safe via mori_log_fork_guard (reopens PID change). write() cross-process visible without fsync, lost reboot. log ops best-effort. Windows: page-file-backed CreateFileMappingA/MapViewOfFile. host must keep mapping handle alive consumers open (GC-chained host extptr ).

title: Shared Memory for R Objects
text: Parallel computing multiplies memory. 8 workers need 200 MB dataset, 1.6 GB serialization, transfer, deserialization. RAM holds 8 separate copies. share() writes data shared memory . worker maps physical pages. Per-worker copies become per-worker references. Without mori, worker holds full data frame. mori, worker holds small reference shared memory region: workers also skip 8 × 200 MB serialization deserialization, gives significant runtime saving:
code: library(mori) library(mirai) library(lobstr)  daemons(8)  # 200 MB data frame — 5 columns × 5M rows df <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(25e6), ncol = 5)) shared_df <- share(df) mirai_map(1:8, \(i, data) format(lobstr::obj_size(data)),           .args = list(data = df))[.flat] |> unique() #> [1] "200.00 MB"  mirai_map(1:8, \(i, data) format(lobstr::obj_size(data)),           .args = list(data = shared_df))[.flat] |> unique() #> [1] "824 B" boot_mean <- \(i, data) colMeans(data[sample(nrow(data), replace = TRUE), ])  # Without mori — each daemon deserializes a full copy mirai_map(1:8, boot_mean, .args = list(data = df))[] |> system.time() #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.672  13.222   8.483  # With mori — each daemon maps the same shared memory mirai_map(1:8, boot_mean, .args = list(data = shared_df))[] |> system.time() #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.002   0.004   4.736  daemons(0)

title: mori (development version)
text: Region layouts now open 64-byte header. share() now supports S4 objects built vectors lists (previously S4 object bit silently dropped). share() attribute-heavy objects nested lists faster: write pass longer re-serializes element just measure size. Fixed type confusion unserialize shared string’s content resembled shared memory identifier (e.g. stored shared_name() value). Fixed forked child process (e.g. parallel::mclapply) unlinking parent’s live region garbage-collecting inherited shared object. Corrupted regions now raise clean R error map_shared() access instead reading bounds crashing R.

title: mori 0.2.2
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-21 Region name counters now start per-process random value, process reusing crashed process’s PID longer collides orphaned regions (#50).

title: mori 0.2.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-09 New prune_shared() removes shared memory regions orphaned process killed clean (#25). share() fails create shared memory region now reports requested size , applicable, actionable hint (e.g. raising container’s /dev/shm limit) instead generic message (#29).

title: mori 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-05-09 Wire-format change (breaking): serialization format shared memory region naming scheme changed. shared_name() map_shared() now round-trip sub-lists extracted elements, just whole shared objects. Sub-object identifiers carry bracketed index path (e.g. /mori_abc_1[2,3]). shared_name() now returns NULL non-shared inputs (previously empty string ""); shared_name(x) %||% "" retains previous behaviour. share() Linux fails clean R error /dev/shm small (typical containers, limit can raised start) instead SIGBUS-ing mid-serialize (#14). map_shared() Linux longer prefaults whole region, restoring lazy first-touch access match macOS.
